name: Haus Alpenrose
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated with lovely views in Soelden, Haus Alpenrose features comfortable apartments and guestrooms with warm Tyrolean charm. It is an ideal haven for hikers and skiers.

The Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl cable car stations and the vibrant village center are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Alpenrose in Soelden offers cosy apartments and guestrooms in a prime Oetztal location.
